title: Use native metrics instead of blanket width multipliers
when: Inline math leaves excess whitespace or overlaps following Korean text.
do: Distinguish EqEdit internal spacing, object width, outer margin, trailing text spaces and paragraph flow.
Prefer exact native EquationCreate dimensions/baseline/margins for the same script, size and environment.
Cache by normalized script, normalizer revision, base unit, font identity, native version and method.
Measure ink-to-next-nonblank glyph for local regressions; shrink only the diagnosed component.
avoid: No universal 1.18/1.25 multiplier or blind global tightening.
check: No overlap, no clipped right edge; baseline stable; cache coverage complete.
limitation: Completed v2 pins native version and font bytes around script/base-unit metric keys. Reuse must compare the environment fingerprint; cross-version reuse is not qualified.
